originalPortraitPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ODETTEPING, a custom Catch! Teenieping-style character transformed from the little girl in reference image 1 using the same character-design transformation logic as Romi becoming Romiping. Image 1 is the appearance/likeness and clothing reference. Image 2 is Romiping and is the precise reference for creature proportions, tiny anatomy, face simplification and polished 3D cartoon rendering ONLY. Preserve the girl's recognizability through straight dark chocolate-brown shoulder-length hair with a soft wispy fringe, subtle lavender hair clip at the side, large dark hazel-brown eyes, softly rounded cheeks and a gentle shy smile. Translate her into a genuinely tiny magical Teenieping creature: very oversized rounded head about 65% of full height, huge glossy expressive eyes, tiny heart-dot nose, little simplified hands, stubby short legs and rounded feet. Do NOT make a normal human child, fashion doll, anime teenager, or human-proportioned chibi. Do NOT borrow Romiping's pink hair or pigtails. Adapt the actual lavender sweatshirt into a sweet lavender long-sleeved tunic with a small white ruffled collar and white ruffle hem, tiny navy leggings with a few pink heart motifs and simple lavender shoes. Friendly neutral full-body character portrait, standing with one small hand waving, head slightly tilted, entire hair and feet visible with a little transparent margin. Match Romiping's glossy high-quality 3D animated toy-like finish, rounded sculpted hair locks, soft studio lighting. Genuine transparent alpha background, no scene, no text, no name lettering, no logo, no watermark, no frame. One character only. This is the master design that will be reused unchanged for judo and piano variations.
